source_comparison.method: Token comparisons preserve strings, ignore comments/whitespace/optional trailing commas and normalize only module facades and narrowed Access/pin visibility. All moved owner, admission, snapshot factory/publication, explicit unpin and Drop bodies match; remaining registry/copy/mapping/close/backing code matches. No backend source changes. Review aid, not formal refinement.

limitations: Mechanical source comparisons aid review, not formal refinement.
Unpin consumes an existing complete pin; only unused preparation or confirmed backend hardware cleanup permits it.
Bare inert Drop retains original snapshot, counters, backing and charge; containing cleanup and outer IRQ/guard/destructor qualification remain separate.
No new physical completion/replay permission, recovery custody, broader pressure/fairness, model change or historical scheduler/metrics/root-close/mapping attribution.
Tracked boot diffs omit untracked new modules; explicit frozen Rust hashes identify the complete changed source set.
